identity.title: Preserve failed result semantics for partial pipeline cancellation

origin.kind: explicit user request and current owner-map review
origin.summary: The user authorized starting the next 2D feature slice from the owner map. The existing execution service stopped before the next step without recording a failed result, allowing a partially completed run to appear successful to callers.

state.current_summary: VisionPipelineExecutionService now records a StepCanceled failure for pre-step cancellation, forces cancellation acceptance to fail, and preserves the existing public VisionRecipeRunner projection. Debug/Release builds and focused cancellation/regression contracts pass.

objective.summary: Make partial pipeline cancellation observable as a failed run while preserving completed step results, existing Preview/Run contracts, and public recipe result projection.
constraints: Work only in C:\Git\2D\Dev; do not modify C:\Git\2D\Original.
Reuse VisionPipelineExecutionService and VisionRecipeRunResult; add no new runtime service, interface, wrapper, or partial.
Keep SDK DLL pins, MVVM boundaries, UI layout, and release/deployment state unchanged.
Store generated logs and reports under D:\OpenVisionLab-TestData\OpenVisionLab_Dev.

criteria.text: Pre-step and between-step cancellation append a failed StepCanceled result, publish the existing CANCEL status update, and return overall failure without executing the canceled step.
Cancellation cannot satisfy ExpectedSuccess=false acceptance, and the public VisionRecipeRunner result exposes Success=false, HasFailedStep=true, and the StepCanceled error code.
An uncanceled two-step pipeline remains successful, and existing pipeline failure-lifetime and Pipeline Review execution contracts remain passing.
The changed execution service and smoke runner build cleanly in Debug and Release, with no solution or runner build errors.
Completion evidence names the current owner, call path, mutable-state writer, lifetime owner, public contract, shortest reading order, focused checks, and the unverified UI/runtime boundary.

artifacts.summary: Debug/Release runner and solution build logs, cancellation contract reports, and regression contract reports.

evidence.observation: The focused cancellation contract completed in both Debug and Release with exit code 0 and passed=5, failed=0. It covered pre-cancel, public runner projection, between-step cancellation, ExpectedSuccess=false acceptance, and uncanceled success.

The existing VisionPipelineExecutionService remains the policy and mutable run-result owner. Its call path is OpenVisionPipelineReviewExecutionController/VisionRecipeRunner -> VisionPipelineExecutionService -> VisionPipelineRunResult.StepResults -> VisionRecipeRunResult. Cancellation writes StepResults through the service; VisionPipelineRunResult owns result disposal and VisionRecipeRunner projects Success/step summaries while disposing step images. The public contract and binding/UI owners are unchanged.
Existing failure-lifetime contracts passed 7/0 in both configurations and existing Pipeline Review execution contracts exited 0 in both configurations after the service change.
VisionRecipeRunnerSmoke Debug/Release rebuilds and full OpenVisionLab.sln Debug/Release builds completed with exit code 0, warnings 0, and errors 0.

Shortest developer reading order is VisionPipelineExecutionService cancellation branch and EvaluateAcceptance helper, then VisionRecipeRunner CreateResult/CreateStepSummaries, then the focused smoke contract. No WPF View or ViewModel changed; this slice has no visual UI mutation. In-process service/public-facade checks are complete, while actual desktop EXE cancellation interaction, alternate themes, DPI/input states, hardware, and SDK portability remain unverified.

events.summary: C1~C5 are satisfied by the service change, public projection contract, Debug/Release builds, focused regressions, and durable owner-map evidence. Close this bounded 2D-002 slice without reopening the completed owner or expanding into UI cancellation interaction.
